top_signal.title: Has your local Chamber of Commerce helped you get clients or sales?
top_signal.summary: I'm wondering if I should join my local Chamber after attending a couple events. On the surface, it feels dated and the only people I seem to meet are just other people looking for clients, so basically everyone needs more work or sales and nobody there seems to actually want to buy or hire anyone...on the other hand, I occasionally meet an interesting person. So far nothing has converted to a sale or a client, however.   Has anyone had any success with a Chamber of Commerce? Is this an overlooked resource, or a dying institution?   This post might be USA - Specific, although I'm sure there are organizations similar to what we call the "Chamber of Commerce" in most cities...       submitted by     /u/aestheticathletic       [link]       [comments]
